name: Kawamura Kyoushirou
source: A Kiko who supervises the entire Oniwaban, and mentors Kiko who just awakens their power. Acting as the mediator between Tomonari and Kunitaka, who have jurisdiction over Buke, he is a man of few words and seems hard to approach. His partner is a hawk that was given to him by Yoshimune.
